question_en:
I have just taken over a small metrology laboratory and am preparing to approve an automated measurement program for use again. The attachment shows the probe module, two stylus-changing racks, and the probe head actually used by the program. Please answer the following questions:

1. Based on the attachment, confirm the manufacturer and product series of this hardware, as well as the exact names of the blue-cap module and the low-force module in this series. Use a table to list separately for both modules: cap color, trigger direction, recommended stylus length range, nominal XY trigger force, and nominal Z trigger force.
2. Identify the probe head and the two stylus-changing racks in the photo, providing their exact model numbers. Explain which stylus-changing rack must be paired with each of the following: the standard probe body of this series and the probe head shown in the image.

Answer format: Please answer in points numbered (1)–(2). Each point should only answer the corresponding sub-question and provide all information required by that question. For point 1, first state the manufacturer, series, and module names, then attach the specification table as required by the question. For point 2, provide the exact model numbers and fixed pairings in text.
answer:
(1) Manufacturer: Renishaw; Series: TP20; Blue-cap module: TP20 6W (6-way); Low-force module: TP20 LF (low force).

| Module | Cap Color | Trigger Direction | Recommended Stylus Length | Nominal XY Trigger Force | Nominal Z Trigger Force |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TP20 6W | Blue | ±X, ±Y, ±Z | 10–30 mm | 0.14 N | 1.6 N |
| TP20 LF | Green | ±X, ±Y, +Z | 10–30 mm | 0.055 N | 0.65 N |

(2) Probe head: PH20; Two stylus-changing racks: MCR20, TCR20; Fixed pairings: Standard TP20 probe body → MCR20, PH20 → TCR20.
